headline: Clarivate Stock Gains Following Positive Stifel Growth Outlook
summary: Clarivate shares moved higher after Stifel issued a positive growth outlook on the company.
why: Clarivate provides critical data, analytics, and information services to corporate and academic research sectors, and analyst sentiment updates frequently drive equity performance.

impacts.name: Clarivate
impacts.why: An upbeat analyst growth outlook boosted investor confidence in the stock.
